neighbours.label: 'such a thing' / French 'une telle': pointing back with disbelief at something named as unlikely
fire: There is no proof that such a thing has ever happened.
Her mother said she would never do such a thing!
Who could imagine such a thing in a quiet town like this?
To suggest such a thing is plainly absurd.
Je ne le croyais pas capable d'une telle bêtise.
Personne n'aurait prévu une telle victoire pour ce club.
How dare you say such a thing to your own father!
Rien ne laissait présager une telle fin pour la saison.
quiet: There is no proof that this bridge has ever been repaired.
Her mother said she would never eat a thing!
Who could fix the old fence in a quiet town like this?
To sell the old car is plainly sensible.
Je ne le croyais pas capable de courir vite.
Personne n'aurait prévu la pluie pour ce match.
How long did you talk on the phone to your own father?
Rien ne laissait présager la fin de la saison.
